Message:
As drops of rain
pelted the window,
my eldest sister spoke softly
through the locked door.

In this town,
girls who haven’t
awakened as witches
by their eighth birthday are,
by law, to be exiled.”

“If the townspeople
found out about you,
they would surely
come to take you away...

For a young girl like you
to survive alone
in the world outside is...”

“...No...
Your discovery could lead
to much worse than that...

My sister’s voice
began to tremble...
As though she had been
truly overtaken with fear...

I’ve never heard her sound
so rattled before...

But, just as I was hesitantly
about to twist the door handle...

Besides my family’s,
that was the first witch’s voice
I had ever heard...
